mechanism: On application startup the main page eagerly queries every per-day history table in the RDB database and materializes all browsing-history rows in memory (Index.aboutToAppear -> RdbUtils.queryAllDate + queryHistoriesByDate for each date), even though history is only consumed when the user opens the browsing-history dialog. Cold-start latency and startup CPU grow linearly with the number of recorded history entries.
fix_summary: History is loaded lazily on first open of the history dialog (PagesDialog.loadHistoryData), and RdbUtils.queryHistoriesByDate now actually awaits the RDB query instead of returning an unfilled array.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
